<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/deactivate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops the credential connecting, without deleting anything. The password, SSH keys, home
directory and network rules are all kept, so activating it again restores access exactly as it
was.

This is the reversible way to cut off access — reach for it rather than delete when you are
responding to a suspected leak, or retiring an integration you might bring back.
